scope: Static source audit of the OPTIONS(DualSense) -> F7 -> Lua RegisterKeyBind dispatch path for the wired UE4SS runtime (composition-5) launching in Silent Hill Townfall on PS5. No console contact, no nested subagents, writes confined to this directory.
port_tree: .superpowers/native-dependency-spike/native-coherent-runtime-1/source/port (ue4ss = runtime, first = RC lib, unreal = engine port)

pad_sources_outside_port_tree.provider: .superpowers/native-dependency-spike/ue4ss-native-pad-provider-1/port/PS5PadSource.cpp + PS5PadNative.cpp (linked as coherent-full-1/native-pad-PS5PadSource.o / native-pad-PS5PadNative.o per native-pad-*.d provenance)
pad_sources_outside_port_tree.config_bridge: native-coherent-pad-runtime-1/build-1/source/NativePadInput.cpp + PS5PadConfig.cpp (verified identical to ue4ss-native-pad-config-1/src/ copies; present as defined symbols in composition-5 candidate combined-supplier.o)
pad_sources_outside_port_tree.backend_that_calls_it: native-coherent-runtime-1/source/bootstrap/ue4ss_backend.cpp is the OLD non-pad revision; the ack-enabled revision WITH the call is worker-composition-3/bootstrap-stage/native-coherent-pad-runtime-1/build-1/source/ue4ss_backend.cpp (line 26) and it is the one linked into composition-5 candidates (objdump reloc evidence)

claims.claim: The pad->key path is fully wired in the composition-5 candidate PRX lineage (worker-composition-5-rebuild prx-candidate-composition5-1 and -2): combined-supplier.o defines parse_ps5_pad_config, make_native_ps5_pad_source, ConfigureRetainedPS5PadInput, and the UE4SSBackend ctor contains a GOT-call reloc to ConfigureRetainedPS5PadInput.
claims.status: verified by nm/objdump on the built objects

claims.claim: OPTIONS->F7 delivery is EDGE-triggered: PS5PadSource::poll emits an InputEvent only on the false->true transition of the chord match (down && !m_down[i]), with a duplicate-sample timestamp guard and phantom-edge suppression; holding the button fires once, release fires nothing.

The chord is OPTIONS ALONE (ini line 'OPTIONS = F7'); matching is AND-of-buttons so extra unrelated buttons do not suppress F7, and it is not a modifier-style chord with a second button. The user presses only OPTIONS.
claims.status: verified against staged PS5Pad.ini sha256 1d919fbf... (2960 B)

claims.claim: Polling runs on the UE4SS-UpdateThread (jthread running UE4SSProgram::update, ~5 ms cadence), NOT the game thread; the Lua keybind callback itself also runs on that thread, and the menu toggle is deferred to the game thread via ExecuteInGameThread using the EngineTick queue drained by engine_tick_hook.

Silent no-popup failure modes are separable from logs: provider failure cannot be silent (startup throw + ack 'failed'), a dead update thread shows 'Event loop start' with healthy mod lines but zero response, an empty bind table shows 'Exception during mod startup' / missing 'Loaded v1.0' line, a dead tick detour is the truly silent one (callback runs, queue never drains), and Lua callback errors log to UE4SS.log per press.
claims.status: verified with citations; see REPORT.md table

claims.claim: Arrow/RETURN mappings matter and match main.lua's six registered binds (lines 694-729); F7 is a toggle (same key opens and closes); no ESCAPE bind exists; nav binds deliberately no-op (no log) while the menu is closed.
claims.status: verified against final-package main.lua sha256 f586043a... (746 lines)

claims.claim: ARTIFACT CAVEAT: the older composition-4 composed runtime object does NOT contain the pad bridge (runtime.map has zero parse_ps5_pad_config / ConfigureRetainedPS5PadInput entries), and worker-composition-5-minimal's PRX is an entry-only module without the runtime. If either of those (rather than prx-candidate-composition5-1/-2) is what is actually installed on the console, OPTIONS will never reach Lua and startup will still look healthy.
